findings.claim: 20-F 風險因素：中國大陸面板廠扶植本土 IC 供應商的政策對 Himax 構成重大挑戰且可能加劇競爭；部分對手隸屬面板客戶，具早期取得產品藍圖與 design-in 優先權的優勢。
findings.excerpt: Also in recent years, policies adopted by Chinese mainland panel manufacturers to actively introduce domestic IC suppliers have posed significant challenges to our business and may continue to intensify competition in the markets in which we operate.

findings.claim: 車用領域 Himax 為全球龍頭：車用 DDIC 約 40% 份額、TDDI 過半、local dimming TCON 更高；in-cell TDDI 對手含 Novatek、Synaptics、FocalTech、ESWIN、Chipone、OmniVision、Ilitek。
findings.excerpt: Himax continues to lead the global automotive display driver IC market, holding approximately 40% market share in DDIC, well over half of market share in TDDI, and an even higher share in local dimming TCON.
